meta.name: json-canvas
meta.description: 产品经理与内容创作者在构建Obsidian知识库或梳理复杂逻辑时，当需要创建思维导图、流程图等可视化画布，使用此技能可自动生成标准.canvas文件，精准配置节点、连线与层级，一键生成完美排版，彻底告别手写JSON的繁琐与报错。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成 Obsidian 画布，把想法连成图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用 Obsidian 记笔记,想用画布梳理思路但不想手写 JSON。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your thoughts into an Obsidian canvas visualization.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Obsidian for notes and want to visualize ideas without writing JSON.

howto.what: Claude 会按 JSON Canvas 1.0 规范生成或修改 .canvas 文件,产出 nodes 与 edges 两个数组:节点可为文本、文件、链接、分组,并带坐标、尺寸、颜色与连线。
howto.when: 当你要为 Obsidian 知识库或梳理逻辑制作思维导图、流程图等可视化画布,或需要读写 .canvas 文件时,它接手生成对应文件。

say.text: 帮我做一张项目看板的 canvas,分成三列分组
say.note: 会生成含分组与文本节点的 canvas 文件

say.text: 把这个流程画成带箭头的流程图 canvas
say.note: 文本节点加带箭头和标签的连线

say.text: 给这张 canvas 的节点加上 1 到 6 的预设颜色
say.note: 颜色可用预设值或十六进制

howto.what_en: Claude generates or edits .canvas files following the JSON Canvas 1.0 spec, producing nodes and edges arrays. Nodes can be text, file, link, or group, each with position, size, optional color, plus edges connecting them.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need a visual canvas such as a mind map or flowchart for an Obsidian vault, or when reading and writing .canvas files.

say_en.text: Make me a .canvas project board with three grouped columns
say_en.note: Produces a canvas with group and text nodes

say_en.text: Turn this process into a flowchart canvas with arrows
say_en.note: Text nodes with arrow edges and labels

say_en.text: Add preset colors 1 to 6 to the nodes in this canvas
say_en.note: Colors as presets or hex values
